title: Same Answer, Different Confidence: Protocol Sensitivity in LLM Confidence Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2605.27752v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLM) can state their confidence in an answer (verbalized confidence), or the confidence can be read from the probability of the answer's tokens (token confidence). Comparisons of the two ask which is better calibrated, but the token probability of an answer depends on the text that precedes it. Across five open LLMs and four question-answering datasets, we fix each answer, its verbalized confidence, and its correctness label, and vary how each score is measured. The scores themselves change with the protocol, and so does the comparison between them. Changing the context in which the token probability is read shifts the gap between the two scores by about the size of the gap itself (.287 vs. .304 in expected calibration error, ECE; .189 vs. .145 in AUROC). translated_title: 相同答案，不同置信度：大语言模型置信度校准中的协议敏感性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以通过语言表述来说明其对答案的置信度（言语化置信度），也可以从答案标记的概率中读取置信度（标记置信度）。对二者的比较旨在探究哪一种校准得更好，但答案的标记概率取决于其前面的文本。在五个开源大语言模型和四个问答数据集上，我们固定每个答案、其言语化置信度及其正确性标签，仅改变每个分数的测量方式。结果表明，分数本身会随测量协议而变化，二者之间的比较结果也是如此。改变读取标记概率的上下文，会使两种分数之间的差距移动大约差距本身的大小（期望校准误差ECE为.287对.304；AUROC为.189对.145）。在20个设置中的19个和17个里，该变化的95%置信区间不包含零，且在AUROC指标下该变化在所有设置中符号一致，因此上下文的改变……
tldr: 该研究发现大语言模型的置信度校准比较结果高度依赖于测量协议——仅改变读取标记概率的上下文，就能使言语化置信度与标记置信度之间的差距移动约一个差距本身的大小，表明现有关于两种置信度孰优孰劣的结论并不稳定。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that comparisons of LLM confidence calibration are highly protocol-sensitive—merely changing the context in which token probabilities are read shifts the gap between verbalized and token confidence by roughly the size of the gap itself, rendering existing conclusions about which confidence type is better calibrated unstable.
